sourceReasoning.topic: REVM lifecycle, gas, journal and refunds
sourceReasoning.assessment: The override preserves the exact default loop's frame_init/frame_run/frame_return_result ordering and error propagation, including no pop for immediate child results. Added code only reads InstructionResult and stores diagnostic state. Pre/post execution, refund and gas-accounting code are unchanged by this scoped diff. This is source reasoning, not an independently executed EVM equivalence test.

sourceReasoning.topic: Immediate child versus returned child versus root
sourceReasoning.assessment: An immediate child Result rejoins the same observation branch as a returned child. evm.frame_return_result returns None when a parent remains, so the result is recorded only for a child. Root immediate results bypass recording; root returned results produce Some and return before recording. frame.rs runs create-return conversion before exposing FrameResult, so those final child outcomes reach the observer.

nested_halt resets before each initial frame_init. Only outer ExecutionResult::Revert serializes nestedHalt; outer Success and Halt retain their existing tags and fields. Therefore a caught child failure does not invalidate an outer success, and successful preparation provenance is cleared before a later sibling.

The client and transport accept absence for legacy compatibility and enforce null or a nonempty string of at most 256 characters only on Revert. Source and executor-code integrity are checked before outcome classification. The independent negative controls confirmed source/code faults remain fatal even with nested/absent metadata.

Explicit nested metadata preserves exact outer kind, phase, preCallIndex and output in exactPrefixFailure without CALL_EXCEPTION or top-level revert evidence. The diff does not modify production final-sim or live pool-revert filtering.

The added Rust fixture contains actual local EVM bytecode for looping OOG, invalid opcode, ordinary child Revert and Stop, with both outer Revert/Success and top-level/inner modes; rollback/success storage and sibling resets are asserted. Immediate precompile Halt and default-loop gas/refund equivalence are covered here by source reasoning, not a new dedicated execution check.
